entry.title: Nvidia forges supplier agreements to expand capacity for AI
entry.summary: The artificial intelligence chipmaker signed deals with six suppliers to scale production of certain components by as much as fifteenfold.

entry.title: Tesla begins humanoid production in California
entry.summary: Early customers for Optimus robots would use them for industrial applications, such as dangerous, repetitive tasks, CEO Elon Musk said.

entry.title: Trump opts for trade talks over tariffs for robotics, industrial machinery
entry.summary: For the second time this month, the president directed cabinet officials to negotiate over imports deemed a threat to U.S. commerce and security by a Section 232 probe.

entry.title: Fed holds main interest rate steady despite accelerating inflation
entry.summary: Two policymakers on the Federal Open Market Committee dissented in favor of raising the federal funds rate by 0.25 percentage point.

entry.title: OPI, Nioxin owner appoints chief supply chain officer
entry.summary: Javier Huerta will oversee The Wella Company’s sourcing, manufacturing and logistics capabilities, effective Dec. 1

entry.title: FedEx drawing parcel-focused shippers to its air freight services
entry.summary: Air freight demand from traditionally parcel-centric customers is rising as the carrier pushes for more business in high-value segments like AI and data centers.

entry.title: Kroger accelerates direct sourcing efforts for better cost control, visibility
entry.summary: The grocery chain seeks to boost first-party procurement volumes to more than 10% while working toward a fully owned import and distribution model.

entry.title: Walmart plans $400M Texas distribution center
entry.summary: The retailer expects to break ground on the more than 744,000-square-foot facility in Cibolo this February.

entry.title: UPS aims to double RFID-labeled volume from customer locations
entry.summary: The carrier expects 6 million packages a day will benefit from the offering in 2027, increasing shipper visibility in the process, CEO Carol Tomé said.

entry.title: USDA to fund 8 fertilizer manufacturing projects totaling more than $1.3B
entry.summary: The agency said the projects will add production capacity to drive prices lower and reduce the nation’s reliance on nutrients from other countries.
